## Data Object Generation

This script build a general data object that will be used to load assays and clinical data throughout the Figure code. This loading code was designed for the IMPACC server and intentionally looks for specified data folders in the codebase function: load_IMPACC_datasets() which you can change to match your directory structure as needed.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("data_loading_codebase.R")
source("~/git_clones/impacc-full-cohort/Analysis/IMPACC_data_analysis_codebase.R")

DATA_VERSION <- "current"
PHASES <- c(1,2,3,4,5,9, NA)
ALLOWED_SMPL_STATUS <- c("IMPACC sample assayed and passed QC", 
                         "IMPACC sample assayed with questionable QC")
KEEP_COVID19_POS <- TRUE
KEEP_ESCALATIONS = TRUE
KEEP_EMORY_CONTROLS = FALSE
EVENT_DATE_UPPER = 999
VISIT_LOWER = 1
VISIT_UPPER = 999
USE_LOCKED_CLINICAL <- TRUE
FILTER_BY_CORE_ASSAY_COHORT = FALSE
FILTER_BY_INTEGRATION_COHORT = FALSE

options(encoding = "UTF-8") # instead of ANSI
options(scipen = 999) # non-scientific output

data_env <- load_IMPACC_datasets(# Data version:
  DATA_VERSION = DATA_VERSION,
  # QC Sample Filtering:
  ALLOWED_SMPL_STATUS = ALLOWED_SMPL_STATUS,
  # COVID-19 Positive
  KEEP_COVID19_POS = KEEP_COVID19_POS,
  # Emory controls:
  KEEP_EMORY_CONTROLS = KEEP_EMORY_CONTROLS,
  # Escalations:
  KEEP_ESCALATIONS = KEEP_ESCALATIONS,
  # Use the locked clinical data (01/01/2023)
  USE_LOCKED_CLINICAL = USE_LOCKED_CLINICAL,
  
  # Don't restrict filtering by manuscript:
  FILTER_BY_CORE_ASSAY_COHORT = FILTER_BY_CORE_ASSAY_COHORT,
  FILTER_BY_INTEGRATION_COHORT = FILTER_BY_INTEGRATION_COHORT,
  
  # event_type / visit upper limits
  EVENT_DATE_UPPER = EVENT_DATE_UPPER,
  VISIT_LOWER = VISIT_LOWER,
  VISIT_UPPER = VISIT_UPPER,
  
  # Phases
  PHASES = PHASES)
## This code was ran on 2024-02-02 using the current data version of that date
saveRDS(data_env, "/scratch/metagenomics/viral_reactivation/2024-02-02_obj.RDS")
## The above path is the one referenced throughout the figure code
```
